_meta.note: Machine-readable per-record freshness registry for leesearch (P0-2). The .md sibling is the human view; THIS file is the source loaders read. Each record carries its own TTL so facts expire independently (a single file-level last_verified cannot). Loader: reffreshness.py — expired/missing/corrupt -> stale/unknown, never re-labeled fresh without a probe. status: observed|announced|effective|degraded|dead|partially-verified|unverified.
